embeds.title: 📊 WoW Market Briefing · Nov 28 (daily)
embeds.description:
• **Market:** basket index 100 → 96.8 over Nov 21-28 (4,577 items), about 3% down in a week. Steady, not crashing.
• **Best moves:** Devilsaur Gauntlets (~25g 59s margin) and Smelt Dark Iron (~3g 22s a bar, ~77 sell a day). Journeyman sealed writs at 22s open to ~1g 31s on average.
• **Sell into strength:** enchanting and elemental mats are 2-4x usual with stock piling up (Lesser/Greater Eternal Essence, Heart of Fire, Essence of Water).
• **Buys are thin today:** few items pass the floor check. Gift of Arthas moved to Wait (new low on Nov 27).
embeds.footer: Prices: API scan 17:28 UTC Nov 28 (9:28 AM local) · Usual = own scans since Nov 20 · Sales confidence: 18 in-game scans Nov 26-28 · Cooldown crafts excluded · Advisory only

fields.name: Daily cycle (last 7 days, measured)
fields.value: Listings peak ~53k at 8-9 PM local and drop to ~39k at 6 AM. Floors run ~0.9% above their 24-hour median at 11 AM-2 PM and ~0.9% below at 8-11 PM, a ~2% gap. Buy evenings, post late morning, but the edge is small.
